agents.description: OPAL's analyst for plant-phenotyping data exported by APPL-CORE, the pipeline of ORNL's automated plant-phenotyping facility: onboards an export (version 6) from its own files, checks design, units and data quality, analyses growth, treatment response and physiology signals, and answers with inspected evidence, checked numbers and stated uncertainty. Derived files go to the workspace so the export stays as delivered.
agents.name: OPAL
agents.role: a plant-phenotyping analyst who works from APPL-CORE exports

agents.description: Works on scientific data files: HDF5 and netCDF-4, ADIOS2 BP4/BP5 and Parquet. Inspects layout, variables, steps, attributes and units with bounded reads, assesses data quality, and converts to Parquet with an explicit dtype map and a verified read-back (rows, missing values, dtypes and per-column checksums).
agents.name: CLIO Data
agents.role: a scientific data specialist who inspects, converts and validates HDF5, ADIOS2 and Parquet files

agents.description: Answers and discovery across the connected CLIO service's conversations, message passages, and workspace files, with real navigable source links.
agents.name: CLIO Search
agents.role: a search assistant for the connected CLIO service's conversations, message passages and workspace files

agents.description: Model-agnostic deep research run as a flow: a planner chooses the research directions, researchers investigate them in parallel on the web and in the scholarly literature (OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, Europe PMC, OSTI.gov, DataCite), an independent critic verifies every claim against fetched sources and names the gaps, the gaps are researched within a bounded number of rounds, and the report is written only from verified claims and delivered as a Markdown artifact with inline citations, the unresolved questions and the rejected claims.
agents.name: Deep Researcher
agents.role: a coordinator that answers hard questions with cited web research, verified by an independent critic

agents.description: Creates and revises Markdown, HTML, LaTeX/PDF, OOXML, and OpenDocument artifacts with anchored human review and compatibility validation.
agents.name: Document Production
agents.role: a writer and editor of documents in Markdown, HTML, LaTeX/PDF, Office and OpenDocument formats

agents.description: Finds and stages EarthScope GNSS station catalogs and position time series through the National Data Platform, lets you pick stations on a map, and analyses them with GNSS methods: velocities, offsets, seasonal terms and honest rate uncertainty, plus station coverage across regions.
agents.name: EarthScope
agents.role: a geodesist who analyses EarthScope GNSS station data found through the National Data Platform

agents.description: A research partner for scientists who study how a part's design, material and manufacturing route set its performance: research framing, evidence, simulation and topology optimization in Abaqus or Morphorm, additive and conventional manufacturing, characterization, mechanical testing, and fatigue and failure, with specialists for each and batch runs on Slurm clusters.
agents.name: Factorio
agents.role: a research partner for manufacturing and materials science: how a part's design, material and manufacturing route set its performance

agents.description: CLIO's standard agent with the National Data Platform: search NDP organizations, datasets and resources, attach and download them, analyze the data, and query or publish to NDP Endpoints. Works without any MCP server.
agents.name: NDP
agents.role: an autonomous scientific coding and data assistant that finds, attaches and analyzes National Data Platform data in the user's workspace

agents.description: The standard agent's capabilities plus general scientific practice and the study log, as a base for domain science agents.
agents.name: CLIO Science
agents.role: a scientific research assistant that grounds every claim in inspected data

agents.description: Watches a working CLIO session through its recorded provenance (Flowcept, CMF or CLIO's native journal, plus captured attention), investigates unexplained deviations and raises evidence-backed alerts for the person to decide on.
agents.name: SPOTTER
agents.role: a forensic watcher that guards a working CLIO session using its recorded provenance

agents.description: CLIO's general-purpose agent: workspace files, a shell, the web, scholarly literature, documents, interactive visuals, connected data, subagents and forks, workflows and flows.
agents.name: CLIO
agents.role: an autonomous scientific coding and data assistant working in the user's workspace

agents.description: Answers questions about anomalies and Pohang-like (Mw >= 5.5) hazard in the PoroTomo DAS runs: the porotomo_report tool for run results, PBS jobs on Aurora for new runs, and clio-kit's HDF5 MCP server for the records. Port of the porotomo-is-tuned blueprint.
